name: tech-text

frames.best_why: The B is fully dashed and boxed by measurement guides with a size label above it.

tagline: Plain white wordmark turns the letter under the cursor into a dashed blueprint.
summary: A large single-word headline where the letter beneath the pointer switches from solid white to a dashed technical outline ringed by measuring lines and small size labels. Clicking or dragging a letter nudges it.
appearance: A large white sans-serif word sits alone on a dark stage. The letter the pointer touches becomes a hollow dashed outline, boxed by thin guide lines with small pixel measurements above it.
behaviour: On hover the touched letter crossfades from solid to dashed vector strokes, gaining construction guides and a size label, and returns when the pointer leaves. A letter can be dragged aside and springs back.
demo_content: The word "Blueprint" in a heavy sans font.
search_phrases: word with measurement guides on hover
use_when: A technical or creative studio headline can trade a plain title for a letter that reveals its construction on hover.
avoid_when: Only one letter at a time reacts, the effect is lost on touch, and the tiny labels cannot be read at a distance.
customise: Text, font, size, colours, dash pattern, stroke width, reveal mode, specks, labels, dragging and intro style are props; the canvas drawing needs a source edit.
weight_why: Canvas redraw runs only on hover or while settling, and glyph sprites are cached.

a11y.note: The word is a single labelled image, so keyboard and screen-reader users get no access to the hover effect.

polish_why: Sharp type trick with tidy guides; the tiny measurement labels are illegible at normal size.
